paragraphs.text:
You’re in section-I, at a junction. A corridor goes straight and 
then seems to slope down. Above, you see stairs heading up. If 
you take the corridor west, go to 371. If you want to climb up 
the stairs, go to 393. If you want to climb down the stairs to the 
east, go to 399.
(305, 371, 393)
